extra_vocab.note: 後面接「結果」，主詞則是原因。合約和通知裡常用它說明違反規定會有什麼後果，語氣客觀、正式。
extra_vocab.pattern: 原因 + result in + 結果（N／V-ing）
extra_vocab.grammar_note: result in 後面接結果，result from 則接原因，方向剛好相反；in 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接 to V。

examples.en: Missing the deadline will result in a penalty fee.
examples.zh: 錯過期限將導致罰款。

examples.en: Please note that late payment may result in extra charges.
examples.zh: 請注意，逾期付款可能會產生額外費用。

examples.en: The new schedule resulted in fewer delays last quarter.
examples.zh: 新的時程讓上一季的延誤變少了。

examples.en: Poor packaging often results in damaged goods during shipping.
examples.zh: 包裝不良常導致貨物在運送途中受損。

similar.diff: 意思很接近，lead to 較口語，也可以接過程中的下一步；result in 強調直接造成的結果。

example.en: Poor planning can lead to higher costs for the company.
example.zh: 規劃不良可能讓公司成本變高。

similar.diff: cause 是及物動詞，後面直接接結果，不需要介系詞 in。

example.en: Heavy rain can cause long delays in delivery.
example.zh: 大雨可能造成配送嚴重延誤。

confusable.diff: result from 表示「起因於」，後面接原因；result in 後面接結果。

example.en: The extra cost results from a late order change.
example.zh: 這筆額外費用是因為訂單太晚更改。

extra_vocab.en: to make someone pay or suffer because they broke a rule
extra_vocab.note: 這篇對話在問提早取消合約會不會有 penalty。penalize 是對應的動詞，指對違約的一方罰款或處分。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用 penalize + 人 + for + 行為，被動則用 be penalized for。

example.en: The contract penalizes any company that delivers goods after the deadline.
example.zh: 合約會處罰任何在期限後交貨的公司。

example.en: Our team was penalized for submitting the report late.
example.zh: 我們的團隊因為太晚交報告而被處罰。

example.en: Penalizing suppliers for small delays may hurt the business relationship.
example.zh: 因小延誤就處罰供應商，可能傷害合作關係。

example.en: The vendor penalizes customers for paying after the due date.
example.zh: 廠商會對超過到期日才付款的客戶罰款。

example.en: Staff will not be penalized for honest mistakes in reports.
example.zh: 員工不會因為報告中的無心之過而被處罰。

example.en: Some banks penalize late payments with high interest charges.
example.zh: 有些銀行用高額利息處罰逾期付款。

examples.en: The agreement penalizes either side that ends the contract early.
examples.zh: 協議會處罰任何一方提早終止合約。

examples.en: We should not penalize customers who pay only a few days late.
examples.zh: 我們不該處罰只晚付幾天的客戶。

examples.en: As noted in my email, the policy penalizes late submissions.
examples.zh: 如我信中所述，該政策會處罰逾期提交。

confusable.diff: punish 是一般的「懲罰」，常針對人和行為；penalize 多指依規則扣款、罰款或處分。

example.en: The manager chose not to punish him for the honest mistake.
example.zh: 經理決定不因這個無心之過懲罰他。

example.en: The company paid a fine for breaking safety rules.
example.zh: 公司因違反安全規定而繳了罰款。

example.en: A late fee is added if you pay after Friday.
example.zh: 如果星期五之後才付款，會加收逾期費。

derived.link: penalize 是「處罰」這個動作，penalty 是它的名詞，指處罰的內容或罰款，像 safety、party 一樣以 -ty／-y 結尾

extra_vocab.zh: 解約罰款、提前終止合約的違約金
extra_vocab.en: money you must pay if you end a contract early
extra_vocab.note: 對話裡男士請同事查「提早取消會不會有罰款」，講的就是 termination penalty。維護、租賃、服務合約裡很常見。
extra_vocab.pattern: a termination penalty + for / of + 金額或條件
extra_vocab.grammar_note: termination penalty 是名詞加名詞的複合名詞，前面的 termination 不加 s，也不要寫成 terminations penalty。

examples.en: The contract includes a termination penalty of two months' fees.
examples.zh: 合約中包含相當於兩個月費用的解約罰款。

examples.en: Is there a termination penalty if we cancel after one year?
examples.zh: 如果我們滿一年後取消，會有解約罰款嗎？

examples.en: Please confirm whether a termination penalty applies to our current plan.
examples.zh: 請確認我們目前的方案是否適用解約罰款。

examples.en: We chose the cheaper plan because it has no termination penalty.
examples.zh: 我們選了較便宜的方案，因為它沒有解約罰款。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同，fee 較常見於電信、租賃等客戶合約；penalty 比較像合約條文的用語。

example.en: The early termination fee is waived after the first year.
example.zh: 滿第一年後，提前解約費用就免收。

similar.diff: 取消訂單、預約或服務時收的費用，不一定是整份長期合約。

example.en: The hotel charges a cancellation fee for changes within two days.
example.zh: 兩天內更改行程，飯店會收取取消費。

confusable.diff: expiration 是合約自然到期；termination 是在到期前由某一方提前終止。

example.en: Our contract reaches expiration in June, so no penalty will apply.
example.zh: 我們的合約六月到期，所以不會有罰款。

extra_vocab.en: the day when something must be paid or finished
extra_vocab.note: 在「A late penalty of five percent applies after the due date.」中，指付款的最後一天，超過就算逾期。多益常見於帳單、發票和繳交文件。
extra_vocab.pattern: before / by / after + the due date
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 介系詞要看意思：by the due date 是最晚到那天，on the due date 是剛好當天，after the due date 是過了之後；不要寫 in the due date。

examples.en: Please pay the invoice before the due date to avoid fees.
examples.zh: 請在到期日前付發票款，以免產生費用。

examples.en: The due date for the sales report is next Friday.
examples.zh: 銷售報告的截止日是下週五。

examples.en: Can we move the due date back by two days?
examples.zh: 我們可以把截止日往後延兩天嗎？

examples.en: Our records show that the due date has already passed.
examples.zh: 我們的紀錄顯示到期日已經過了。

examples.en: The supplier agreed to extend the due date by one week.
examples.zh: 供應商同意把到期日延長一週。

similar.diff: deadline 較常用於工作、申請和專案的最後期限；due date 更常用於帳單、付款和歸還。

example.en: We must send the proposal before the deadline on Monday.
example.zh: 我們必須在星期一的截止時間前寄出提案。

similar.diff: cutoff date 是受理的最後一天，過了就不再接受，用於報名、訂單和申請。

example.en: The cutoff date for registration is the end of this month.
example.zh: 報名的截止日是本月底。

confusable.diff: expiration date 是有效期限（優惠、保固、產品失效的日子），不是要付款或完成工作的日子。

example.en: The expiration date of the warranty is printed on the card.
example.zh: 保固的到期日印在卡片上。

extra_vocab.en: an extra amount of money added to the usual price
extra_vocab.note: 這篇談到 installation fee 可能被免收，surcharge 則是另一種常見的附加費。議價時要問清楚有沒有額外加收。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: surcharge 是可數名詞；後面常接 on + 商品或服務，或 for + 原因，例如 a surcharge on weekend deliveries。

example.en: The invoice lists two surcharges that we did not expect.
example.zh: 發票上列了兩項我們沒預期到的附加費。

forms.label: 第三人稱單數
forms.zh: 加收費用（第三人稱單數）

example.en: Our carrier surcharges every package shipped after the deadline.
example.zh: 我們的貨運公司對截止後寄出的每個包裹加收費用。

example.en: The shipping company surcharged us for the oversized package.
example.zh: 貨運公司因為包裹過大而向我們加收費用。

example.en: Some airlines are surcharging passengers for checked bags this year.
example.zh: 有些航空公司今年開始對託運行李加收費用。

example.en: Some restaurants add a surcharge on holiday weekends.
example.zh: 有些餐廳在假日週末會加收附加費。

example.en: The vendor agreed to waive the surcharge for new customers.
example.zh: 廠商同意對新客戶免收附加費。

example.en: There is a surcharge of ten dollars for rush delivery.
example.zh: 急件配送要加收十美元的附加費。

examples.en: The surcharge on this invoice was not in our agreement.
examples.zh: 這張發票上的附加費不在我們的協議中。

examples.en: A surcharge applies to bags over twenty kilograms.
examples.zh: 超過二十公斤的行李要加收附加費。

examples.en: Ask the supplier whether any surcharge applies to rush orders.
examples.zh: 請問供應商急單是否有任何附加費。

examples.en: Let's compare the total price, including any surcharge.
examples.zh: 我們來比較含所有附加費的總價吧。

confusable.diff: surcharge 是在原價之外多加費用；discount 是從原價扣掉一部分，方向相反。

example.en: The vendor offered a discount instead of adding a surcharge.
example.zh: 廠商提供折扣，而不是加收附加費。

example.en: The installation fee is included in the price.
example.zh: 安裝費已包含在價格裡。

example.en: There is no extra charge for online payment.
example.zh: 線上付款不另外收費。

example.en: The total price includes tax and all shipping costs.
example.zh: 總價包含稅金和運費。

example.en: A small surcharge is added to all credit card payments.
example.zh: 所有信用卡付款都會加收一筆小額附加費。

example.en: The shop surcharges customers who pay by credit card.
example.zh: 這家店對用信用卡付款的客人加收費用。

extra_vocab.en: an extra fee added to the price when fuel costs go up
extra_vocab.note: 是附加費的一種，常出現在運輸、航空和物流帳單。談合約時，要確認報價是否已含這筆費用。
extra_vocab.pattern: A fuel surcharge + be added to + N
extra_vocab.grammar_note: fuel surcharge 是可數名詞，常用被動 be added to the bill，或用 apply 表示「適用」；fuel 不加 s。

examples.en: A fuel surcharge was added to this month's bill.
examples.zh: 本月帳單加收了一筆燃油附加費。

examples.en: The shipping company charges a fuel surcharge on all overseas deliveries.
examples.zh: 這家貨運公司對所有海外配送加收燃油附加費。

examples.en: Does the quoted price include the fuel surcharge?
examples.zh: 報價有包含燃油附加費嗎？

examples.en: Please note that the fuel surcharge changes every month.
examples.zh: 請注意，燃油附加費每個月都會調整。

examples.en: The airline raised its fuel surcharge on long flights.
examples.zh: 航空公司調高了長程航班的燃油附加費。

similar.diff: 名稱比較正式，常見於貨運和能源合約，意思幾乎相同。

example.en: A fuel adjustment charge appears on every freight invoice.
example.zh: 每張貨運發票上都有燃油調整費。

similar.diff: extra charge 泛指任何額外費用，不限燃油。

example.en: There is no extra charge for standard delivery.
example.zh: 標準配送不另外收費。

confusable.diff: fuel cost 是燃油成本，是公司自己付的；fuel surcharge 是公司另外向客戶加收的費用。

example.en: Fuel costs rose, so the carrier added a surcharge.
example.zh: 燃油成本上漲，所以貨運公司加收了附加費。

extra_vocab.en: money you pay first to keep something or as a promise
extra_vocab.note: 談合約時常見的先付款項。提早取消時，訂金可能不退，所以要先看條款，這和對話裡擔心的 penalty 有關。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 訂金用 a deposit on／for + 東西，例如 a deposit on the equipment；把錢存進帳戶則用 deposit + 金額 + into + 帳戶。

example.en: The contract lists two deposits, one now and one later.
example.zh: 合約列出兩筆訂金，一筆現在付，一筆之後付。

example.en: Our finance team deposits customer checks every Friday morning.
example.zh: 我們的財務團隊每週五早上存入客戶的支票。

example.en: I deposited the payment into your account this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上已把款項存入您的帳戶。

example.en: Depositing the full amount today will secure your booking.
example.zh: 今天存入全額就能保住您的預約。

example.en: Customers must pay a deposit to reserve the meeting room.
example.zh: 客戶必須付訂金才能預約會議室。

example.en: The deposit is refundable if you cancel within seven days.
example.zh: 七天內取消的話，訂金可以退還。

example.en: A security deposit is required before you rent the office.
example.zh: 租辦公室之前需要先付押金。

example.en: She made a deposit at the bank before lunch.
example.zh: 她午餐前去銀行存了款。

examples.en: The supplier asked for a thirty percent deposit before production.
examples.zh: 供應商要求在生產前先付三成訂金。

examples.en: If we sign for three years, can they reduce the deposit?
examples.zh: 如果我們簽三年，他們可以降低訂金嗎？

examples.en: We received your deposit and will confirm the order tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們已收到您的訂金，明天會確認訂單。

examples.en: The hotel will keep the deposit if you cancel late.
examples.zh: 如果您太晚取消，飯店會扣留訂金。

confusable.diff: payment 是任何一次付款；deposit 是為了保留或保證而先付的那一筆。

example.en: The final payment is due after the equipment is installed.
example.zh: 尾款在設備安裝完成後到期。

example.en: We will send a full refund within five business days.
example.zh: 我們會在五個工作天內寄出全額退款。

example.en: Please pay the remaining balance by the end of the month.
example.zh: 請在月底前付清剩餘的尾款。

example.en: You can pay the fee in three monthly installments.
example.zh: 您可以分三個月分期支付這筆費用。

derived.link: deposit + -or，做這個動作的人，像 actor、visitor

example.en: A small deposit secures your seat at the training seminar.
example.zh: 付一小筆訂金就能保住您在培訓講座的座位。

example.en: Please deposit the cash into the company account by noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把現金存入公司帳戶。

senses.en: money you pay first to hold an order or a booking

example.en: We paid a deposit to hold the conference room.
example.zh: 我們付了訂金來保留會議室。

senses.en: money you give first and get back if nothing is damaged
senses.distinguish: 押金通常會退還，用於租賃或借用設備；訂金則是買東西或預約時先付、之後算進總價。

example.en: The office rental requires a deposit that we get back later.
example.zh: 租辦公室需要付一筆之後會退還的押金。

senses.en: money that you put into a bank account
senses.distinguish: 和 bank、account 一起出現時是存款；和 reserve、rent、order 一起出現時是訂金或押金。

example.en: The bank confirmed your deposit of two thousand dollars.
example.zh: 銀行確認了您兩千美元的存款。
